outcome: preterm delivery (very preterm: 22-31 gestational weeks; moderately preterm: 32-36 gestational weeks)
cohort: The study included 465,836 Swedish women with their first two consecutive singleton live births between 1992 and 2012.
finding: Among normal-weight women, high interpregnancy weight gain or loss was associated with spontaneous moderately preterm delivery, while high interpregnancy weight gain also increased the risk of medically indicated preterm delivery.
